description:
Add a contributor architecture document for the repository-state/materialization subsystem and correct the stale storage-abstraction pointer in the core system-design document.

## Background

The repository-state/materialization subsystem is roughly 15,000 lines with no contributor architecture document: `dev/architecture/` covers nothing about it, and `crates/jit/src/repository_state/mod.rs:1-6` is the only pipeline overview, at six lines. A new document at `dev/architecture/repository-state-materialization.md` must give a contributor a working mental model of the subsystem: the single captured repository view, the pure planning boundary that derives a materialization plan from that view, and the one recoverable publication mechanism - together with the mutation-session contract that command modules drive, the file-transaction kernel and its journal, and the materialization/projection flow including repair derivation. The document describes the subsystem as it exists in `crates/jit/src/repository_state/` and `crates/jit/src/storage/`; module and file names and pipeline stages must match the current sources.

Separately, `dev/architecture/core-system-design.md:198-202` still lists "Storage abstraction (NEXT) ... See docs/storage-abstraction.md." That file does not exist and the work is long done; the pointer is stale and must be swept.

This is a documentation task: follow the content standards in `.jit/reference/content-standards.md`, use Mermaid for any diagram, and state current behavior only (no "previously/no longer" narration).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `dev/architecture/repository-state-materialization.md` exists and documents the subsystem for a contributor: the captured-view -> pure-planning-boundary -> recoverable-publication pipeline, the mutation-session contract, the file-transaction kernel and journal, and materialization/projection with repair derivation.
- [hard] REQ-02: The module names, file paths, and pipeline stages named in the document match the current `crates/jit/src/repository_state/` and `crates/jit/src/storage/` sources.
- [hard] REQ-03: `dev/architecture/core-system-design.md` no longer references the non-existent `docs/storage-abstraction.md`; the "Storage abstraction (NEXT)" block at lines 198-202 is replaced with accurate current text that points to the new architecture document where appropriate.
- [hard] REQ-04: Any diagram uses Mermaid, and the document describes current behavior without before/after narration.

## Notes

The document reflects the settled subsystem surface, including the single mutation-session boundary, rather than any interim shape.
title: Write the repository-state architecture doc and sweep the stale storage pointer
